metadata.text: WePollin is an interactive polling application that allows users to create, share, and participate in various types of polls. It's user-friendly and accessible on multiple devices.
WePollin is completely free to use for all basic features. Premium features may be introduced in the future, but core functionality will remain free.
You can create polls with multiple question types, including multiple choice, rating scales, open-ended questions, and add images or media. You can also schedule polls for future dates.
WePollin provides real-time analytics with live results tracking, voter demographics, response rate monitoring, and export options to CSV or Excel.
WePollin allows public or private polls, password protection for sensitive polls, voting limits per person/device, and options to allow or restrict multiple responses.
You can share polls via direct links, embed on websites, social media integration, and QR codes for easy access.
WePollin is fully mobile-optimized, responsive, touch-friendly, works across all devices, and requires no app installation.
To create an account, click 'Sign Up', enter your email and password, verify your email, and complete your profile setup.
If you forgot your password, click 'Forgot Password', enter your registered email, follow the email link, and set a new password.
To create a new poll, log in, click 'Create Poll', enter your question and answers, configure poll settings, and click 'Create'.
You can create multiple types of polls: multiple choice, single selection, rating scale, open-ended, image-based, and time-based polls.
To vote in a poll, click the poll link, select your preferred answer(s), and click 'Submit'. You can change your vote if the poll is still active.
Your data is secure. All information is encrypted and handled according to data protection regulations.
You can make polls private so only people with the direct link can access them.
If you are not receiving the verification email, check your spam folder, confirm your email address, wait a few minutes, or contact support.
If a poll isn't loading, check your internet connection, refresh the page, clear browser cache, or try a different browser.
View poll results in real-time with our live updating system.
Get detailed insights about poll responses with our analytics dashboard.
Share polls easily via social media or direct link.
You can submit feature requests through our website or by emailing features@wepollin.com.
